newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian bonds, futures paddle sideways at close.
newsitem.headline: Italian bonds, futures paddle sideways at close.

text.p: 1530 GMT - Italian debt markets drifting sideways at close as markets watch for any signs for future of EMU and Italy's role within it. Rumours have upset market slightly today but official denials rebalanced markets by close. Benchmark cash BTP weak but other cash bonds firm.
* Bonds:Feb07 -11bps at 97.61, yield 7.21 pct, spread vs 10-yr Bund 139 bps.
* Lira:983.05/3.25 per mark, unchanged from earlier.
